messages:
Nina Park: Partner Helio wants a marketplace private offer combining reserved commit + hardware rebate + SI onboarding credits. They want a single SKU bundle and a joint webinar 2 weeks post-launch. Need draft terms + webinar owner by Thurs.
Evan Li: Sounds doable. For the bundle SKU we should include a clear breakdown: appliance rebate (one-time), monthly consumption commit, and onboarding credits (one-off) so billing and fulfillment teams can reconcile.
Oscar Grant: Ops note: dedicated capacity for first 30 days, then fall back to shared pools with rate limit. We'll need SKU pin for dedicated pools. Also recommend a soft cap (e.g., 120% of monthly baseline) to avoid surprises.
Nina Park: Commercial ask from partner: 20% appliance rebate if commit >= $400k, plus 10% onboarding credit applied month 1. Otherwise rebate 10% and 5% onboarding. Can we model that?
Evan Li: I'll draft the pricing matrix and pro-forma. Quick pseudocode: 
```
if commit >= 400000:
  appliance_rebate_pct = 0.20
  onboarding_pct = 0.10
else:
  appliance_rebate_pct = 0.10
  onboarding_pct = 0.05
```
Evan Li: Also propose renewal trigger: if run-rate > 115% two months in a row we notify and offer a top-up commit with additional credits. No auto-charge.
legal-bot: Legal checklist created: trademark sign-off, clear opt-in for top-up, export controls, and SLA language required. See internal legal task po-9912.
Oscar Grant: I'll prepare SKU->pool mapping + fallback ops runbook by EOD Wed. Include contact matrix for incident escalation.
Nina Park: Webinar owner? @Evan can you run webinar with Field Marketing? Need slides and partner quote by next Mon.
Evan Li: Happy to run it. I'll sync with Field Marketing and draft slides. Will post invite options in #events.
Nina Park: Great. Final deliverables: Evan pricing + webinar, Oscar ops mapping, Legal to confirm checklist. Internal review Fri AM, partner review Mon. :rocket:
